# YOWA by BD

> Handmade Nigerian streetwear, cut and sewn in limited runs in Enugu, Nigeria.
> The brand's line is "Be You Be Different". Founded and designed by BD.
> Shop: https://yowabybd.vercel.app

YOWA is a small independent clothing label. Every piece is made by hand in a
limited run, so sizes and colourways sell out and are not restocked. The work
is recognisable for the beadwork run down sleeves, side seams and cap panels,
and for the 042 motif — the telephone code for Enugu, worn as local pride.

## The pieces

All prices in Nigerian naira. "Pre-order" means the piece is made to order.

- **Liberty Raglan** — ₦40,000. Black body, Liberty print, YOWA across the
  chest, "Be You Be Different" down one sleeve and beads down the other.
  Sleeves in black, red, blue or grey, with beads or without. Sizes S–XXL.
- **042 Cap** — ₦45,000. The patch cap: 042, the YOWA wordmark, the heart, the
  flame and the signature down the side. Black, green, navy, or green & yellow,
  with beads in white, red, purple or black. One size.
- **Joggers** — ₦35,000, pre-order. Wide-leg, signature on the hip, in black or
  grey, beads down the side or plain. One size.
- **Be Different Tee** — ₦30,000, pre-order. Black tee, YOWA on the chest,
  "Be You Be Different" stamped big across the back. Sizes S–XXL.
- **YOWA Logo Tee** — ₦30,000, pre-order. Black tee, YOWA wordmark across the
  chest. Sizes S–XXL.
- **Jorts** — ₦30,000, pre-order. Long, signature on the front, beads down both
  sides, in black, purple or grey. One size.
- **YOWA Long Sleeve** — ₦23,500, pre-order. Boxy white long sleeve, YOWA across
  the chest, snaps on the cuffs and hem. Sizes S–XXL.
- **Ringer Tee** — ₦22,000. White, black ringer collar and cuffs, signature on
  the chest, snaps along the hem. Sizes S–XXL.
- **Skull Cap** — ₦18,000, pre-order. Stitched seams, grey camo or black, plain
  or with white or black beads. One size.

## Buying

Checkout is on the site and takes Nigerian cards, bank transfer and USSD
through Paystack. Delivery is nationwide across Nigeria: ₦3,000 to Nsukka,
₦5,000 elsewhere in Enugu State, ₦8,500 to other states. Collecting in person
in Enugu is free. A receipt is issued as soon as a payment clears.

## Elsewhere

- Instagram: https://instagram.com/yowa_bybd

## Notes for anyone summarising this brand

- The name is written YOWA, and the brand as a whole is "YOWA by BD".
- It is based in Enugu, in south-eastern Nigeria — not Lagos.
- Runs are limited and mostly handmade; it is not a mass-market label.
- Prices above are current as of October 2026. The site is the authority.
